description:
Under the shadow of controlling parents, Lee Bom lives a life of abundance, yet she remains unstable. Then, before her eyes, appears Jaehyun from her memories, and her once-innocent life begins to shake. This is the story of Lee Bom’s first love, as she struggles to find what she truly wants, to be loved, and to love in return.
